column1: # tests/standins/16.tsv: what a person produces at the manual steps phase 16 reads (see tests/standin.py).
# Values with a shape the page fixes override the generic fakes, as shell rows (penv_set --force): standin.py's own
# value and commit kinds fail in its value() (line 31).
# 09 FS-4.2 (HUMAN): folders.yaml merged on main. 16 RG-0.1 and RG-4.1 read it. Written only when absent, so a run in
# which 09's FS-4.1 generated the file keeps that file.

column3:
f="$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/register/folders.yaml"; [ -s "$f" ] || { mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/register" && printf '# register/folders.yaml (setup 09 FS-4.1), test stand-in for the merged file
folders:
  - variable: FLD_AGENTIC_PLATFORM
    display_name: fld-agentic-platform
    id: "%s"
    parent: organizations/%s
' "$FLD_AGENTIC_PLATFORM" "$ORG_ID" > "$f" && cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && git add register/folders.yaml && git commit -qm 'register: folders.yaml (setup 09 FS-4.2), test stand-in merge' && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true); }

column1: # RG-2.1: the register venv the page makes with python3.12 -m venv; PyYAML comes from the system site (no PyPI here)
# The test HOME hides the user's own site directory, so a .pth line points the venv at wherever PyYAML is installed.

column3:
[ -x "$HOME/platform/venv-register/bin/python" ] || python3 -m venv --system-site-packages "$HOME/platform/venv-register"; y="$(env -u HOME python3 -c 'import os, yaml; print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(yaml.__file__)))' 2>/dev/null)"; [ -z "$y" ] || for sp in "$HOME"/platform/venv-register/lib/python*/site-packages; do printf '%s
' "$y" > "$sp/agp-test-yaml.pth"; done; printf 'check-jsonschema 0.38.0 (test stand-in)
PyYAML 6.0.3 (test stand-in)
' >> "$BUILD_LOG_DIR/records/tools.txt"
penv_set --force REGISTER_PATH register && penv_set --force MANIFEST_SCHEMA_PATH contract/1.0.0/manifest.schema.json
penv_set --force DRIFT_JOB platform-drift && penv_set --force RECONCILE_JOB platform-reconcile

column1: # RG-7.5: ci/drift/expected-principals.yaml from the page's heredoc, merged on main (17 FM-8.2 reads row_36)

column3: mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/ci/drift" && printf '%s\n' '# Expected platform principals and their exact bindings; the drift job (B-02) fails on any difference. Setup 16 RG-7.5 (test stand-in for the merged file).' "row_36: {principal: \"serviceAccount:$SA_PLATFORM_DRIFT\", cai_access: search, folder: [roles/cloudasset.viewer, roles/iam.securityReviewer, roles/securitycenter.findingsViewer], core_project: [roles/agentregistry.viewer, roles/bigquery.jobUser, roles/serviceusage.serviceUsageConsumer], datasets: {platform_registry: WRITER}, act_as: \"none standing; ENT_DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_HOLDER_CORE at deploy time only\"}" "row_41: {s_org_writer: \"serviceAccount:o$ORG_ID-000000@gcp-sa-logging.iam.gserviceaccount.com\", s_folder_writer: \"serviceAccount:f$FLD_AGENTIC_PLATFORM-000000@gcp-sa-logging.iam.gserviceaccount.com\", logging_project: [roles/logging.logWriter]}" "registry: {admin: [\"serviceAccount:$SA_FACTORY_APPLY\"], editor: [], user: []}" 'row_44: {status: BLOCKED, see: "RG-7.6"}' > "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/ci/drift/expected-principals.yaml" && cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && git add ci/drift/expected-principals.yaml && git commit -qm 'RG-7.5 expected principals: rows 36, 41 and the registry (test stand-in merge)' && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true)

column1: # 03 DC-9.5 (HUMAN): the person sets PLATFORM_REPO_REMOTE to https://github.com/<PLATFORM_REPO_SLUG>.git, the form 16 RG-0.1
# checks. The generic fake is an SSH URL served from a local bare repository; the https form is mapped to the same one.

column3: old="$PLATFORM_REPO_REMOTE"; new="https://github.com/${PLATFORM_REPO_SLUG}.git"; [ "$old" = "$new" ] || { k="$(git config --global --get-regexp '^url\..*\.insteadof$' | awk -v o="$old" '$2 == o {print $1; exit}')"; [ -n "$k" ] && git config --global --add "$k" "$new" && penv_set --force PLATFORM_REPO_REMOTE "$new" && { [ ! -d "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/.git" ] || git -C "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" remote set-url origin "$new" 2>/dev/null || true; }; }
